jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Night Shift | Earn €20.85 per hour! – Become an essential link at SKF
jobs.description:
Are you ready to work night shifts and do you already have some experience as an order picker? Then this is your chance!

SKF, specialized in bearings, seals and lubrication systems, is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly daily. We are looking for motivated warehouse workers who provide top-quality service to our customers.

What will you do?? Collect and prepare orders like a true professional? Work with a high order-picking truck (no fear of heights!)? Grow step by step thanks to internal training

Your work schedule:Fixed night shift: Monday evening 22:00 – Saturday morning 06:00 Full-time or part-time. For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? A high school diploma and initial experience as an orderpicker?? No fear of heights and good physical condition?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English?? Strong numerical skills, attention to detail and spatial awareness

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Wielsbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in 2 shifts. As a preventive maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in a 2-shift regime

Context

 

Our client is going through a large-scale IT transformation. They're looking for an experienced Solution Architect who loves both the big picture and the technical detail, and who wants real impact in a technology leadership role.

 

 

What you'll do

• Design solutions that matter. You'll own end-to-end architecture for key IT initiatives, making sure they're robust, secure and fit for purpose.

• Be the bridge. You'll connect Enterprise Architecture with the delivery teams, turning strategy into solutions that actually get built.

• Team up. You'll work hand in hand with business owners, domain architects and engineers to deliver high-quality results.

• Shape the roadmap. You'll define target architectures and roadmaps for a core business domain, using your hands-on experience.

• Build for reuse. You'll create solution patterns and building blocks that other teams can rely on.

• Share what you know. You'll lead communities of practice, exchange lessons learned with fellow architects and help the architecture practice grow.

 

What you bring

• 10+ years in IT, with solid experience as a Solution Architect on large transformation programmes.

• Strong architecture skills: event-driven and service-based architectures, microservices, RESTful APIs.

• Agile and DevOps experience at scale, including CI/CD. SAFe knowledge is a nice bonus.

• A TOGAF certification, or a similar one.

• Tech you've worked with: .NET, Angular, Azure, Kafka, SQL, BPM/low-code platforms, mainframe backends and SaaS packages.

• The ability to zoom in and out: you're as comfortable writing a strategy document as solving an implementation challenge.

• A pragmatic mindset: you go for what works, not what looks perfect on paper.

• Autonomy and sharp analytical skills: you break down complex problems across teams and locations and come up with actionable answers.

• Strong communication skills: you can convince project teams and senior management alike.

• A mentor's spirit: you enjoy helping newer architects grow.

• Fluent English.

 

Nice to have

• Experience in financial services and its regulatory environment.

• Knowledge of capital markets.

• Familiarity with frameworks like Open Agile Architecture.

-

Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
